blocks.text: `while` repeats the indented part as long as the condition is true. Something must eventually make it false, otherwise you get an endless loop.
The condition is checked at the **start** of every round; if it is false at first sight the body never runs.

blocks.prompt: Start `x` at 1 and double it every round; stop when `x` is above 100, then print `x`.

blocks.q: With `n = 0`, how many times does the body of `while n > 0:` run?
blocks.why: The condition is false right away, so the body never runs.
